query: Identify global Oxygen Minimum Zones (OMZs, O₂ ≤ 20 μmol/kg) during 2010-2020 and analyze their biogeochemical characteristics: (1) Calculate mean OMZ thickness in the Eastern Tropical Pacific (20°S-20°N, 80°W-120°W), Arabian Sea, and Bay of Bengal; (2) Compute the nitrate-to-phosphate ratio (N:P) within OMZs and compare with the Redfield ratio (16:1); (3) Quantify the temporal trend of OMZ total oxygen content and assess its correlation with ENSO Niño 3.4 index.
